name: Direforge Hill
summary: Hostile Dark Iron dwarves hold Direforge Hill in the northeastern Wetlands, southeast of Dun Modr and northeast of the Green Belt.

sections.title: A Bastion of Dark Sorcery
sections.body: Balgaras the Foul commands the Dark Iron dwarves on Direforge Hill. Their encampment lies southeast of Dun Modr, in the northeastern Wetlands.

sections.title: The Threat to the Wetlands
sections.body: Travelers crossing the northeastern Wetlands must pass near the hostile Dark Iron encampment on Direforge Hill. Balgaras the Foul commands the dwarves there.

faq.answer: Direforge Hill rises in the northeastern Wetlands, southeast of Dun Modr and northeast of the Green Belt. It lies northwest of the rocky bluffs of Raptor Ridge.

faq.q: Who controls Direforge Hill right now?
faq.answer: Hostile Dark Iron dwarves hold Direforge Hill under Balgaras the Foul, a warlock.

faq.q: Why is Direforge Hill significant to the Wetlands?
aliases: what is happening at direforge hill
faq.answer: Direforge Hill holds a hostile Dark Iron encampment in the northeastern Wetlands. Balgaras the Foul and his dwarves threaten travelers crossing the region.

Balgaras the Foul is a Dark Iron dwarf warlock who commands the forces encamped at Direforge Hill. His corrupted arts and aggressive presence in the hills make him a priority target for those defending the marsh.

angles.text: As a Bronzebeard dwarf of Ironforge, you see the Dark Iron clan's treachery reach the Wetlands. Warlocks like Balgaras answer for it in cold steel.
As a druid passing through the Wetlands, you must contend with the hostile Dark Iron encampment on Direforge Hill.
